title: 第17章 太猛了快憋不住了第18章 师尊别这么激动
slug: 救了元婴宗主夫人醒后她急了
content_zh:
;;
柳师师深吸一口气，似乎下了极大的决心。
她伸出如葱白般的手指，轻轻点在陆长生眉心。
“听好了。”
“这秘法由我主导。本源入体，痛切心扉。你得熬过碎骨重塑的坎儿，熬不住，我会切断经脉。你想借我的势往上爬，就得咽得下这份活罪！”
陆长生反手扣住她的手腕，顺势将那细软的指节攥进掌心。
“好。男人嘛，怎能说不行？”
柳师师提着裙摆在他对面盘膝坐下。
两人膝盖抵在一起。
“那就开始了。”柳师师冷哼一声，“闭眼！沉心静气！”
陆长生盯着近在咫尺的脸，喉结滚了滚。
“师尊，咱们这流程不对吧？”
“闭上你的狗嘴！”
柳师师气得脸色泛红，她懒得跟这逆徒磨嘴皮子。双手抬起，掌心平摊，直抵陆长生的双掌。
陆长生不再说话，闭目运转长春功。
掌心一软，温润细滑的触感瞬间贴合。
没等他好好捏一捏，一股极度狂躁滚烫的本源之力蛮横撞破经脉，直冲五经八脉！
剧痛炸开。
陆长生脸色瞬间煞白。无数气刃在血肉里疯狂绞杀，骨头嘎吱作响。
元婴期的纯阴本源，远比想象中猛烈百倍！

“这口气绝对不能泄！泄了就难成成功了！”
陆长生疼得直哆嗦，硬是从牙缝里挤出几个字。
“师尊……缓一缓……你这太猛了……我这小身板……受不住……”
柳师师呼吸一滞，周天运转差点岔了气。
“给我憋着！护住心脉！”
陆长生只觉全身窍穴都要被强行撑破。
“师尊，我的丹田……要爆了！”
“不准爆，憋住！”
柳师师连往日的架子也顾不上了。
“太猛了……快憋不住了……”
陆长生面皮剧烈抽搐。
“我给你加把火！直接冲破枷锁！”
柳师师反客为主，十指强行挤入陆长生的指缝，死死扣紧。
陆长生发出一声闷哼。
content_en:
;;
Master Liu took a deep breath and seemed to have made a great determination.
She stretched out her green-white fingers and gently touched the center of Lu Changsheng's eyebrows.
"Listen up."
"This secret method is controlled by me. The source enters the body and breaks the heart. You have to survive the hurdle of broken bones and reshaping. If you can't survive, I will cut off the meridians. If you want to use my power to climb up, you have to swallow this living sin!"
Lu Changsheng grabbed her wrist with his backhand and squeezed the soft knuckles into his palm.
"Okay. As a man, how can you say no?"
Master Liu held up his skirt and sat cross-legged opposite him.
Their knees were touching.
"That's it." Master Liu snorted coldly, "Close your eyes! Calm down!"
Lu Changsheng stared at the face so close to him, his Adam's apple rolling.
"Master, is our process wrong?"
"Shut your bitch!"
Master Liu's face turned red with anger. She was too lazy to argue with this traitor. He raised his hands and spread his palms flat, directly touching Lu Changsheng's palms.
Lu Changsheng stopped talking and closed his eyes to perform the Changchun Kung Fu.
The palm of your hand is soft, and the warm and smooth touch instantly fits you.
Before he could give it a good squeeze, an extremely manic and hot source of power violently broke through the meridians and rushed straight into the five meridians and eight meridians!
The pain exploded.
Lu Changsheng's face instantly turned pale. Countless air blades strangled crazily in the flesh, and the bones creaked.
The pure yin origin of the Nascent Soul stage is far more powerful than imagined!
"You must not let your breath out! If you let it out, it will be difficult to succeed!"
Lu Changsheng shivered in pain and managed to squeeze out a few words through his teeth.
"Master... slow down... you are too fierce... my little body... can't bear it..."
Liu Shishi's breathing was stagnant, and Zhou Tianxun almost lost his breath.
"Hold it in! Protect your heart!"
Lu Changsheng felt that the acupoints all over his body were being forcibly stretched.
"Master, my Dantian... is about to explode!"
"Don't explode, hold it in!"
Master Liu didn't even care about his usual airs.
"It's so fierce...I can't hold it in anymore..."
Lu Changsheng's face twitched violently.
"I'll give you more fire! Break through the shackles directly!"
Liu Shishi turned his back on his guests and forced his fingers into Lu Changsheng's fingers, clasping them tightly.
Lu Changsheng let out a muffled groan.
